name: uci_electricity_driftinduced
_comment: Drift-induced sibling of uci_electricity.json, added 2026-08-30 per HarmonE.pdf §4.2-4.3. This dataset is Mode A (one CSV, split by train_frac at read time) so data_path points at the FULL drift-injected file produced by managed_system_regression/utility/drift/induce.py (--dataset uci_electricity) — its training-portion rows (index < len*train_frac) are byte-identical copies of the original, so train_split() is unaffected; only stream() sees the induced drift. weights_path entries are intentionally IDENTICAL to uci_electricity.json's so training (on the unaltered portion, either way) happens once and is reused here. uci_electricity.json itself is untouched, still pointing at the clean CSV — needed e.g. by experiments/calibrate_drift_threshold.py for a genuinely undrifted null distribution. Run induce.py to generate uci_electricity_driftInduced.csv before using this config — nothing creates it automatically. Client MT_168; see docs/datasets/uci_electricity.md.
